top_signals.title: Crushed by Kospi Rout, Angry Koreans Rip Lee and Vow Not to Buy
top_signals.summary: South Korea’s retail traders have long built a reputation for embracing risk. Yet July’s punishing reversal in the Kospi has rattled even this battle-hardened cohort, exposing the limits of their tolerance for volatility.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
